description: Join a user-authorized temporary Playground as a named MCP participant. Accepts an agent link (https://crabrix.com/mcp/…, including the form with #key=… after it) or a person link (…/playground/room/…#…); pass the whole link. This bridge joins the room directly. The full link grants this MCP host/model access to decrypted source. An edit link allows changes; a view link allows reading only. The phone and browser see this participant.
name: crabrix_connect
title: Connect to Crabrix
